profile.headline: Software Engineer at ByLight Veraxx
profile.summary:
I served in U.S. navy for 5 years, worked in the team environment is the key.
After the experience in the navy I discovered my passion in problem-solving. I could never forget the excitement and satisfaction of solving the problem after tackled it for a few days. That led me to pursuit a bachelor's degree in computer science. Worked as a team player and a team manager to push the projects forward way before deadlines is my goal to success. 
I am currently working for L3Harris as associate software engineer and also the lab manager for the current project. Implemented software changes and updates according to customer requirements. Took on software lead for the most recent project as well as supporting system engineers on hardware issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer working with C++ on a daily basis. Travel on site and implement changes and cold starting simulators.
positions.insights: Problem Solving, Active DoD Secret Clearance and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer at L3Harris worked on Government contracts and supportted the team on improving technology.

positions.title: Gas turbine technician
positions.description: I was doing maintenance on the gas turbine onboard of the naval ship. After 2 years I was transfer to oil lab onboard of the same vessel. We took on thousands of gallon of fuel and tested them to see if it's within the requirement standard(refuel on shore and out to sea). Refueling the helicopter and testing aviation fuel were also within our duties.

organizations.name: US Navy
organizations.description: Implemented a leak prevention on fuel connection, that results in no leakage during refueling over 9,000,000 gal of fuel, reduced refueling incidents by 99% and improvement of environmental safety.

organizations.name: US Navy
organizations.description: Implemented in-house troubleshooting and maintenance schedule on fuel oil purifier, that results in reduced cost to hire civilian contractors which saved navy over $30,000.
